item.title: Credit-Builder Cards UK: Best Cards to Build Credit in 2026
item.description:
Quick answer: Credit-builder cards are designed for people with poor or no credit history. They have low limits (£150–£1,500) and high APRs (30–40%), but if you spend a small amount monthly and pay in full every month, you pay zero interest while building your credit score. After 6–12 months of good behaviour, you can graduate to standard cards. Best providers: Aqua, Capital One, Vanquis, and Barclaycard Forward.
